title: Understanding Two Key Poker Terms: Fold and Bluff
summaryJa: ポーカーの「フォールド」は自分のハンドを降りることで、「ブラフ」は弱いハンドで勝つために嘘をつく戦術です。これらはテキサスホールデムで非常に重要な基本的な用語です。
segments: In Texas Hold'em poker, two important words are fold and bluff. New players must understand these terms.
They help you make good decisions at the table. To fold means to quit the current hand.
You throw your cards away. You do not play anymore in that round.
For example, the dealer shows the flop. You see three community cards.
You have a weak hand. Another player bets a lot of money.
You decide not to win this hand. You fold.
You lose any money you already put in the pot. But you stop losing more money.
A bluff is different. A bluff means you bet or raise when your hand is weak.
You want other players to think you have a strong hand. They may fold instead of playing.
Then you win the pot without showing your cards. For example, you have very bad cards before the flop.
But you are in a good position. You bet big money like you have a great hand.
Other players are afraid. They fold.
You win their money. Your weak hand wins the round.
Fold and bluff are opposite ideas. When you fold, you give up.
When you bluff, you fight. Good players use both strategies at the right time.
Knowing when to fold saves money. Knowing when to bluff wins money.
Practice these skills to become a better poker player.
